title: Reliability- and Anatomy-Consistency-Aware Multimodal Learning for Robust Fracture Classification from Bangladeshi Radiographs
abstract: arXiv:2608.21482v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Background: Multimodal fracture classifiers may benefit from patient and anatomical metadata, but they can also become brittle when contextual information is missing or mismatched. Methods: We studied 1493 radiographs from the Bangladeshi OrthoFrac-XR dataset using leakage-safe age, sex, bone type, and laterality. A ConvNeXt image encoder was combined with a clinical multilayer perceptron through concatenation, late fusion, reliability-gated residual fusion, and a hierarchical state-location formulation. We additionally introduced an anatomy-consistency gate that attenuates metadata corrections when an image-side anatomical prediction disagrees with the reported bone type. Results: Across five folds and three seeds, hierarchical residual fusion achieved a macro-F1 of 0.6046 +/- 0.0279, compared with 0.5727 +/- 0.0270 for image-only learning, while improving the Brier score from 0.5239 to 0.4948. translated_abstract: 背景：多模态骨折分类器可能受益于患者和解剖学元数据，但当上下文信息缺失或不匹配时，它们也可能变得脆弱。方法：我们研究了来自孟加拉国OrthoFrac-XR数据集的1493张X光片，使用泄漏安全的年龄、性别、骨骼类型和侧别信息。我们将ConvNeXt图像编码器与临床多层感知器通过拼接、晚期融合、可靠性门控残差融合和层次化状态-位置公式相结合。我们还引入了一个解剖一致性门控，当图像侧解剖预测与报告的骨骼类型不一致时，该门控会减弱元数据校正的影响。结果：在五折交叉验证和三种随机种子下，层次化残差融合实现了0.6046 ± 0.0279的宏F1分数，而仅图像学习为0.5727 ± 0.0270，同时将Brier分数从0.5239提高到0.4948。在五折稳健性实验中，一个
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合可靠性门控残差融合与解剖一致性门控的多模态骨折分类方法，在孟加拉国X光片数据集上显著提升了分类稳健性和校准性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multimodal fracture classification method integrating reliability-gated residual fusion with an anatomy-consistency gate, significantly improving robustness and calibration on Bangladeshi radiographs.
